solution:

4) At last, the elements follow the second type of movement.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8c861801ce2173c4938a9ff2930d245c06799abdadf010d5c0790490e54bfbc0.png]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b875e4679610fa638ab40dbe72989b382ad265a37217f02d2903549b9fbfac78.png] 

Hence, ‘option - (3)’ is the correct answer.
